relationships.subject: High-fat diet
relationships.evidence_quote: HFD-fed WT animals also displayed the robust upregulation of chemokine CXCR4 expression with increased macrophage infiltration, which was never observed in HFD-fed CB2 knockout mice.

relationships.subject: CB2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, CB2 knockout animals showed significant resistance to HFD-induced neuroinflammation.

key_findings: CB2 knockout mice were resistant to high-fat diet-induced hypersensitivity, CXCR4 upregulation and macrophage infiltration.
CB2 signaling may be pro-inflammatory depending on the cause of inflammation.
